summary: Barclays PLC files a 6-K announcing a £500 million share buy-back programme commencing after the completion of its current £1 billion buy-back, ending no later than October 24, 2026. The buy-back aims to reduce share capital; repurchased shares will be cancelled. J.P. Morgan Securities plc acts as riskless principal for on-market purchases on the London Stock Exchange, with trading decisions made independently. No US repurchases allowed. The programme uses the existing shareholder authority granted at the May 2025 AGM. This is a routine capital return event. Watch for updates on buy-back pace and completion relative to the £1.43 billion remaining authorized capacity.
